description: This header file defines the API for the Device.IP.Diagnostics.TraceRoute object in a TR-069 device. It includes function prototypes for getting and setting trace route diagnostic parameters such as DiagnosticsState, Interface, Host, NumberOfTries, Timeout, DataBlockSize, DSCP, MaxHopCount, ResponseTime, and RouteHopsNumberOfEntries. The functions facilitate remote management of IP diagnostics for trace route testing.

methods.name: get_Device_IP_Diagnostics_TraceRoute_DiagnosticsState
methods.description: Retrieves the current DiagnosticsState indicating the status of the trace route diagnostic process.

methods.name: get_Device_IP_Diagnostics_TraceRoute_Interface
methods.description: Obtain the IP-layer interface (source IP address) used for the trace route test.

methods.name: get_Device_IP_Diagnostics_TraceRoute_Host
methods.description: Retrieve the host name or address that the trace route test is targeting.

methods.name: get_Device_IP_Diagnostics_TraceRoute_NumberOfTries
methods.description: Get the number of tries per hop configured for the trace route test.

methods.name: get_Device_IP_Diagnostics_TraceRoute_Timeout
methods.description: Get the timeout duration (ms) for each hop in the trace route test.

methods.name: get_Device_IP_Diagnostics_TraceRoute_DataBlockSize
methods.description: Obtain the size in bytes of data blocks sent in each probe.

methods.name: get_Device_IP_Diagnostics_TraceRoute_DSCP
methods.description: Retrieve the DSCP value used for trace route packets.

methods.name: get_Device_IP_Diagnostics_TraceRoute_MaxHopCount
methods.description: Get the maximum hop count (TTL) used in probe packets.

methods.name: get_Device_IP_Diagnostics_TraceRoute_ResponseTime
methods.description: Get the response time (ms) of the most recent trace route attempt.

methods.name: get_Device_IP_Diagnostics_TraceRoute_RouteHopsNumberOfEntries
methods.description: Retrieve the number of hop entries recorded in the route table.

methods.name: set_Device_IP_Diagnostics_TraceRoute_DiagnosticsState
methods.description: Set the DiagnosticsState to trigger or update the trace route diagnostic.

methods.name: set_Device_IP_Diagnostics_TraceRoute_Interface
methods.description: Specify the source IP interface for the trace route.

methods.name: set_Device_IP_Diagnostics_TraceRoute_Host
methods.description: Set the target host for the trace route.

methods.name: set_Device_IP_Diagnostics_TraceRoute_NumberOfTries
methods.description: Configure the number of tries per hop.

methods.name: set_Device_IP_Diagnostics_TraceRoute_DataBlockSize
methods.description: Configure the data block size in bytes.

methods.name: set_Device_IP_Diagnostics_TraceRoute_DSCP
methods.description: Set the DSCP value for the trace route packets.

methods.name: set_Device_IP_Diagnostics_TraceRoute_MaxHopCount
methods.description: Set the maximum hop count (TTL) in probe packets.
